metadata.description: Software testing and QA skills for Claude, in non-overlapping packs. Generated from testland/qa.

plugins.name: testland-essentials
plugins.description: Core QA workflow for any team: test strategy and planning, test data and environments, test review against conventions, test reports and CI results, CI integration, and flaky-test triage.

plugins.name: testland-backend
plugins.description: Testing backend and distributed systems: async jobs and queues, caches, concurrency and race conditions, database migrations, distributed tracing, feature flags and experiments, sagas and CQRS, serverless functions, and time and timezones.

plugins.name: testland-api
plugins.description: Testing APIs and integrations: REST API tests, consumer-driven contracts, GraphQL, gRPC, auth flows (OAuth, OIDC, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta), real-time protocols, email and push notifications, and payment flows.

plugins.name: testland-security
plugins.description: Security testing and compliance: SAST, DAST, dependency, secret and SBOM scanning, infrastructure-as-code checks, fuzzing, compliance controls, test-data privacy, and multi-tenant isolation tests.

plugins.name: testland-web
plugins.description: Testing web front ends: browser end-to-end tests, visual regression, accessibility, localization, PDF and print output, browser extensions, and progressive web apps.

plugins.name: testland-unit-testing
plugins.description: Unit and code-level testing: unit tests for JavaScript and TypeScript, Python, JVM, .NET, Go and Rust, mutation testing, property-based testing, BDD, and CLI tool tests.

plugins.name: testland-ai
plugins.description: Testing AI and data systems: LLM evaluation and red-teaming, ML model tests, search relevance, AI-assisted test generation and review, and data quality checks.

plugins.name: testland-mobile-desktop
plugins.description: Testing native apps and devices: iOS and Android, desktop apps, embedded and hardware-in-the-loop systems, and games.

plugins.name: testland-performance
plugins.description: Performance, resilience and production checks: load testing, chaos and resilience drills, synthetic monitors, canary validation, and release runbooks.

plugins.name: testland-manual-testing
plugins.description: Manual and exploratory testing: test design techniques, exploratory charters and sessions, bug reproduction and reports, defect tracking, and test case management.

plugins.name: testland-leadership
plugins.description: Quality leadership and planning: QA team management and reporting, test impact analysis, code-quality gates, and shift-left reviews of specs and designs.
